# Numbers and Synchronicities

A Skill Harbor house build for anyone who keeps noticing the same numbers, from the committed believer to the honest sceptic. Numbers and Synchronicities starts from a discipline most angel number apps skip entirely: it notes and it counts, and it affirms no cosmic meaning. You report each sighting, 11:11 on the phone, 222 on a receipt, 444 on a plate, and your Muse logs it with the date, the time, the context and how it felt, in a folder that stays on your device. Nothing is interpreted at logging time unless you asked for the traditional association to be shown.

The honest part is the counting. The journal also logs the days you notice nothing, and it keeps days you never touched separate, as unknown, instead of quietly treating them as empty. Reviews therefore always show both sides: occurrences per number, active journal days, empty days, and the real noticed frequency over the window. A short base rate reminder travels with every review: you look at the time often, only striking glances get remembered, watching for a number makes you notice it more, and clusters happen by chance when there are many numbers, contexts and days.

For coincidences that genuinely struck you, you flag them when they happen, and at review time you give the verdict yourself: real link for me, chance, or in between, recorded in your words, with pending verdicts named as pending and chance verdicts kept in the tally like the others. Traditional associations for digits 0 to 9, master numbers 11...
